from collections import Counter
def split_v(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    allc=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    for c in range(W):
        col={g[r][c] for r in range(H)}
        if len(col)==1 and allc[next(iter(col))]==H:
            return [row[:c] for row in g], [row[c+1:] for row in g]
def split_h(g):
    allc=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    for r in range(len(g)):
        if len(set(g[r]))==1 and allc[g[r][0]]==len(g[0]):
            return g[:r], g[r+1:]
